description: Source code for WebSocket HTTP/3 handshake stream implementation in Chromium, handling WebSocket over HTTP/3 with request/response processing, validation, and stream management.

classes.name: WebSocketHttp3HandshakeStream
classes.description: Implements WebSocket handshake over HTTP/3, managing request/response lifecycle, validation, and stream upgrade.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request info for the handshake.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream with priority, net log, and timestamp.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends WebSocket handshake request headers over HTTP/3.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream and disconnects adapter.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Processes received response headers, validates upgrade.

methods.name: ValidateResponse
methods.description: Validates the server response code and headers.

methods.name: ValidateUpgradeResponse
methods.description: Validates the upgrade response headers for WebSocket handshake.
